bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · holding the 100-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 守住 100 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 1.8% on Oct 19 to $538.05, ending a three-day decline. It is below the falling 5-day ($561.1) and 10-day ($592.4) averages and the rising 30-day ($580.3), but above the rising 100-day ($526.2) and 200-day ($395.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and is still above zero with a widening gap, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($610.7), and RSI is 40.5.
read.zh: AMD 10月19日上涨 1.8%，收于 $538.05，结束连续三日下跌。股价位于下行的 5 日（$561.1）和 10 日均线（$592.4）以及上行的 30 日均线（$580.3）下方，但位于上行的 100 日（$526.2）和 200 日均线（$395.9）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，且差距扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$610.7），RSI 为 40.5。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $530 Oct 15 low, and the 100-day average zone ($526–527) held for a second session. Resistance is $554–561 (Oct 19 high, 5-day average), then $567–571 (Oct 14 low and close) and $580 (30-day). Support is $526–530 (100-day average, Oct 15–16 lows), then $495–498 (late-June and early-July lows). A close below $526 would open $497; a close above $561 would target $570–580.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $530 的 10月15日低点，100 日均线区域（$526–527）连续第二个交易日守住。阻力为 $554–561（10月19日高点、5 日均线），其次 $567–571（10月14日低点和收盘价）和 $580（30 日均线）。支撑为 $526–530（100 日均线、10月15–16日低点），其次 $495–498（6月下旬和 7月初低点）。若收盘跌破 $526，下一目标看 $497；若收盘站上 $561，可看向 $570–580。
